text: Worms are common in scavenging chickens, reducing efficiency and raising susceptibility to other disease; preventive deworming every 3 months with Tetramisole (100 mg per adult chicken) is recommended. For Coccidiosis — which causes bloody diarrhea in chicks and can be fatal — Toltrazuril, Amprolium, and some sulfonamides (Sulfadimidine, Sulfamethoxine) are active treatments; starter feed for chicks (0–21 days) often already contains Salinomycin specifically to prevent Coccidiosis.
